phone.auto-sync.why: The PC-side policy is only enforcement once it reaches the phone. Without the sync timer the phone keeps whatever policy it was last given, so a tightened blocklist silently never lands on the device it was tightened for.
phone.auto-sync.cost_of_bypass: None needed on this machine: the unit was never installed, so the policy has never been pushed from here at all. Re-running install_pc_phone_automation.sh unchanged would also produce a broken unit, because its ExecStart target moved when phone-focus-mode was extracted out of testsAndMisc.
